reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 3 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 60 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: Denver's travel was messy: travel delays after Saturday's Mexico City game got them back only hours before Monday's loss in Houston. They have had a day to reset since. Memphis have the league's second-youngest roster and are 5-0 on the road but have lost three straight at home. A tired Denver and a young team uneasy at home roughly cancel out, with a slight lean to Denver now that it has had rest.
